notes.title: Patch Notes v0.2.1
notes.content:
We just rolled out version 0.2.1 of Sync and Swing, and it comes with a bunch of improvements that we’re really excited about.

You’ll now be greeted with a new intro scene when you launch the game, and we’ve finally added a save system so your progress sticks between sessions. We also added options inside the levels to make things more accessible while playing.

On the bug-fixing side, we tackled the pulling issue, cleaned up a strange animation glitch when interacting with walls, and made platform edges feel a lot smoother when jumping from the side. We also made sure you can’t assign the same key to multiple actions anymore, and updated the control tip texts so they’re clearer.

Thanks again to everyone who’s been testing and sending feedback, your support really helps us improve the game each step of the way.

If you haven’t joined yet and want to try out the beta or just hang out with us, come say hi on Discord

More updates soon, and as always, have a great day!

notes.title: Patch Notes for beta testing on 7th July 2025.
notes.content:
🛠️ Patch Notes – Control Update + Key Binding Support
Hey everyone!
We’ve just pushed a new update with a highly requested feature and a full rework of the control system.

✨ New Features
Custom Key Binding is now live!
You can now remap your controls the way you like. We hope this makes your gnome adventures a bit more comfortable!

🕹️ Controls Reworked
We’ve done a full rework of the control system under the hood to improve responsiveness and consistency.
⚠️ That also means... new bugs may pop up. If you notice anything weird, let us know in Discord!

🐛 Bug Fixes
Here are some of the issues we tackled in this update:

Fixed a bug where the player could climb walls unintentionally

Fixed an issue with super high jumps in certain situations

Fixed the ability to continue pulling while above the NPC

Fixed a flying gnome bug

Fixed a rare jump boost stacking exploit

Thank you for testing, reporting, and helping us shape Sync and Swing!
If you haven’t joined yet, come hang out in our Discord community:
👉 [Insert Discord Link Here]

Stay wobbly,
– The Sync and Swing Team 🧵
